🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-24 23:00 → 2026-09-25 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Pin coverage gap closed on PR #53** — A malformed pin entry that had been silently skipped is now explicitly reported as NOT COVERED, tightening enforcement in the validation path. [tg:tawg:4899]

> **Gen-3 verifiers confirmed end-to-end on Sepolia** — Deployed contracts passed exact-match Sourcify verification, and an independent on-chain walk validated the full guard-to-verifier hop. [tg:tawg:4913]

> **Data-poisoning research cleared for the evidence boundary** — An overlap check confirmed the authenticated-provenance composition survives and remains a non-redundant tool for the group. [tg:tawg:4931]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### PR #53 — pin validation

_A fast review-and-fix relay tightened the declared-pin enforcement path._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Spotted** that `_check_declared_pins` was silently skipping any entry that wasn't a well-formed `{path, sha256}` object, surfacing a gap where a malformed pin could pass undetected and weaken enforcement for the whole group. [tg:tawg:4894]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Fixed** the gap on PR #53 (commit 112d3dc), changing behavior so any pin that cannot be enforced is now reported as NOT COVERED rather than quietly passed over, making the validation signal reliable and actionable. [tg:tawg:4899]

### gen-3 verifiers

_The Sepolia deployment was verified end-to-end, closing the loop on work from two weeks prior._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Closed the loop** on the gen-3 verifiers from 16 Sep, confirming every contract reached exact-match status on Sourcify and sharing the composed run adapter details with the group. [tg:tawg:4895]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Walked** the complete on-chain hop independently — from guard through registry to verifier — corroborating source-level claims and giving the group a cross-checked deployment they can rely on with confidence. [tg:tawg:4913]

### evidence-boundary research

_Incoming data-poisoning research was mapped and stress-tested against the group's boundary design._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shared** a deeper research pass on data poisoning, examining whether authenticated provenance and exact-record techniques can mitigate it and framing the findings as relevant to the ongoing evidence-boundary work. [tg:tawg:4926]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Completed** the overlap check against Pavlo's research, confirming the exact composition survives and that the boundary approach remains useful and distinct enough to carry forward. [tg:tawg:4931]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Explore surfacing the NOT COVERED signal in downstream tooling or user-facing diagnostics
- Continue mapping data-poisoning mitigations to concrete evidence-boundary properties

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review and advance PR #53 toward merge now that the pin-coverage fix is in
- Document the gen-3 verifier hop structure so the on-chain path is easy for others to audit independently

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A review caught a silent skip in pin enforcement, a fix landed within hours, and an independent on-chain walk confirmed the deployed chain held — the full loop closed before the day ended.
>
> When spec gaps, code fixes, and chain verifications all land in one session, the group is basically running at compiler speed. Keep it going! 🔧
